evidence.loss_aversion_framing: Säkerställa tydliga definitioner och hög datakvalitet; Erfarenhet av data governance
evidence.loss_aversion_framing_explanation: Data quality and governance framing signals a moderate concern with reliability, secondary to the primary framing around building and delivering data products.

evidence.greenfield_vs_fix_explanation: The JD explicitly frames the work as building something from scratch, not legacy, but also describes developing/extending an existing dbt layer, giving weight to greenfield without being a pure zero-to-one build; on balance the fix/scale framing of an existing dbt layer under a Head of Data dominates.
